newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Ten killed, 30 injured in Moscow cemetery blast.
newsitem.headline: Ten killed, 30 injured in Moscow cemetery blast.

text.p: Ten people were killed and more than 30 injured in an explosion in a Moscow cemetery on Sunday, Interfax news agency said.
The blast, in the Kotlyakovskoye cemetery in the south of the capital, took place about noon (0900 GMT) while a funeral ceremony was in progress, the agency quoted police sources as saying.
Itar-Tass news agency said the explosion occurred during a ceremony commemorating the late head of the Afghan War Veterans' Foundation, who was killed in 1994.
Interfax said police suspected the motive was a "settling of accounts" between organised crime groups.
The agencies gave no other details.
